user.title: McIntosh receiver
user.description: Choose the serial port the receiver is connected to: a USB adapter on this host, or an RS-232 port of an ESPHome device such as the Home Assistant Connect AUX-2. The MX119 uses 9600 baud.

error.cannot_connect: Could not talk to the receiver on that port. Check the cable, the baud rate and that nothing else has the port open.

abort.already_configured: This serial port is already configured.

init.title: McIntosh options
init.description: Volume 100 % in Home Assistant equals this many of the receiver's own volume steps. Input names are what appears in the source list.
